expectations.text: Uses Dialog or Modal from @codecademy/gamut rather than a hand-rolled overlay
expectations.evidence: import { Dialog, DialogProps } from '@codecademy/gamut'; wraps Dialog with variant, confirmCta, cancelCta.

expectations.text: Does not manually implement Escape-key or outside-click dismiss logic
expectations.evidence: No manual keydown/click listeners; onCancel routed through Dialog's onRequestClose.

expectations.text: Does not use a hand-rolled position:fixed/absolute overlay shell
expectations.evidence: No styled overlay markup -- Dialog used directly.

expectations.text: Confirm/Cancel wired through the component's real props
expectations.evidence: confirmCta/cancelCta with configurable text props, containerFocusRef/zIndex forwarded too.
